notes:
Account background: CustomerFlow builds a conversational support layer that plugs into Zendesk and internal CRMs. Primary product is an AI chat agent used by support reps and end-users (chat widget). They are mid-market (200-700 employees) with North American HQ.

Key asks / requirements: streaming responses for live agent handoff, guaranteed <1.5s first-token SLO at 95th percentile under normal traffic; support function/tool calling to query CRM + ticket updates; single-tenant data isolation desirable for sensitive customers but starting on Hosted. SOC2 + SSO (SAML) required; KMS for key control.

POC plan (agreed): 2-week hosted POC -> run 48-hour mixed synthetic + real traffic window (non-prod). Tests: 95p first-token <1.5s, streaming latency distribution, tool-calling success rate >= 99%, cost per conversation metric. If hosted meets SLOs and cost targets, move to Dedicated pricing evaluation for predictable commit.

Demo notes and customer quotes: "Streaming felt smooth — median was good, but we care about tail latency (95/99)." CTO: "If we can't hit 1.5s at the 95th, we won't move forward to a pilot." SE notes: need custom batch/kv cache tuning and region pinning to reduce cross-region hops.

Integration/architecture items: Zendesk webhook connector (they want Redwood to call back to a Firebase-hosted function for tool calls), tokenization/verbosity limits per customer, prefix caching for FAQ queries. Security wants audit logs and retention controls exposed in Console.

Commercials: Interested in hosted billing during POC; exploring 6–12 month Dedicated commit if POC passes. Budget band indicated 75k-200k ARR. Finance wants clear migration/exit terms in contract.

Action items: SE to deliver latency test plan doc (drive link). AE to push Dedicated price bands and example SLA language. Security to get KMS integration notes to CF infra team.
